text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Director of Israel's Centre for Urban and Rural Studies, Dafina Schwartz, is in Angola to explore the possibility of establishing an institute for finances and administration for demobilised soldiers.
- The assistant director for demining for Germany's foreign affairs ministry is to visit Angola from January 23 to hold talks with the government and relief organisations.
